review: author visual inspection of all outputs plus read-only metadata/source/reference hash checks
limitations: No native frame extraction, fixed palette, integer pixel-grid, timing, animation loop, engine registration or gameplay verification. Dense illustration PNGs are not production sprites. Finite gestures stop at the third keyframe.

entries.visual_inspection: Same character/costume across three panels. Single blank tag starts intact; short slit appears in second and remains in third; corner remains connected and no detached scrap is present. Last two poses hold the tear without restoration or escalation. No refund or signature cue.
entries.limitations: Paper hinge is small and should be enlarged/cleaned during native sprite production; slight pixel/cloth variation is not strict registration.

entries.visual_inspection: Same seated man/table/stool and pouch. Anonymous face-up map becomes one upright blank-backed sheet with empty tabletop beneath, then one flat blank creased reverse. No address or transaction. Full boots/furniture visible; left table corner touches canvas edge.
entries.limitations: Fold proportions and exact hand anchors vary slightly; map diagrams are abstract art proposals, no known geography. Border lines were generated despite no-border preference, harmless editorial deviation.

entries.visual_inspection: Only lower-reference woman appears. One vertical old board, same board lowered in both hands, then laid across one chair seat with hands withdrawing. One chair each panel, no other person/ritual/transaction/return or death evidence. Costume retained.
